caption:
Set this up BEFORE you lose your phone. 📱

1. Open your phone's settings and find the "find my device" feature
2. Turn it on, and allow location
3. Check you can see the phone from a computer

scenes.text: If you lose your phone today, can you find it?

scenes.myth: I'll set up tracking after my phone is lost.
scenes.fact: It only works if it was turned on beforehand.
scenes.say: Myth. I'll set up tracking after my phone is lost. Fact. It only works if you turned it on beforehand.

scenes.title: Turn on find my device
scenes.say: Three steps. Open your phone's settings. Turn on the find my device feature. Allow location access.

scenes.title: Use a screen lock
scenes.body: A PIN or biometric lock keeps strangers out if it goes missing.
scenes.say: Extra tip. Use a screen lock, so strangers can't get in if it goes missing.
Not set up, and it's gone for good. Set up, and you can locate, lock, or erase it.
